treasure.name: Gold ring
treasure.summary: A plain gold band, worn thin on one side. Worth its weight and no more.

treasure.name: Silver chain
treasure.summary: A fine silver neck chain, the pendant long lost.

treasure.name: Signet ring
treasure.summary: A heavy gold ring cut with a merchant house's crest. Someone, somewhere, misses it.

treasure.name: Pearl necklace
treasure.summary: A string of river pearls, still lustrous under the grime.

treasure.name: Dwarven gold armband
treasure.summary: A broad band of red dwarven gold, etched with the hammer of the Kiln-Wardens.

treasure.name: Emerald ring
treasure.summary: A gold ring set with an emerald the size of a pea. Wix thought it was a button.
